title: Hard-Boiled Jamaican Egg Frittata
description: A funky, pillowy, cozy Jamaican dish featuring egg, pressure-cooked to perfection. Gluten-free-friendly and perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a large bowl and whisk them together with a fork until they're lightly beaten.
Add the shredded cheese, curry powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir until they're well combined.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat until it's melted and fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they're heated through, about 2 minutes.
Pour the egg mixture over the tomatoes in the skillet and cook until the edges start to set, about 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to a pressure cooker and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Remove the skillet from the pressure cooker and let it cool slightly.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Slide the frittata out of the skillet onto a serving plate and garnish with chopped scallions and cilantro.
Serve the frittata warm, sliced into wedges.
Garnish with additional chopped scallions and cilantro if desired.
Serve with toasted bread or a side salad for a complete meal.
Adjust the seasoning as needed and serve hot.
Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving for a fluffier texture.
Cook the frittata to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) for food safety.
Let the frittata cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
